cohort: A single neonate with a prenatally diagnosed right congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) and a subsequently diagnosed choledochal cyst (CC).
finding: Surgical repair of a symptomatic choledochal cyst (CC) should not be delayed, even in the presence of mesh, given the risks of CC complications, and CC should be considered in the differential diagnosis of progressive cholestasis in patients with congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH).
followup_time: Approximately 13 months after birth (12 months after choledochal cyst surgery, which occurred on day of life 41)
